NATIONAL CEREALS AND PRODUCE BOARD
Notice to farmers: 2026 long rains fertiliser subsidy prices.
The subsidised price of DAP fertiliser is KSh 2,000 per 50kg bag for the 2026 long rains season.
CAN fertiliser is KSh 1,800 per 50kg bag. NPK 17:17:17 is KSh 2,200 per 50kg bag.
Prices apply at all NCPB depots nationally from 10 February 2026.
Farmers redeem their e-voucher at the depot named in the allocation SMS.
Stock levels are announced by each depot manager weekly.
